title: Skater and Critic
body:
We have $$	ext{skate\_record},$$ a DataFrame where each row describes a skating performance with the following columns:
• critic 1: Critic 1's rating on the performance.
• critic 2: Critic 2's rating on the performance.
• comment: An audience comment on that performance.
• self rating: The skater's self-rating on the performance.
All ratings are between $$0$$ to $$100$$ inclusive.
We consider a constant model that predicts $$	ext{critic\_1}.$$
